feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Reporting on the money that flows through our economy, from Wall Street financial firms to Silicon Valley tech giants, small businesses, consumers, employers and workers. Plus podcast episodes of Planet Money and The Indicator.

entry.title: U.S. Judge rules FCC violated ABC's free speech rights to please Trump
entry.summary: A federal judge has blocked the Trump administration from moving to review all local broadcast licenses held by ABC. The stations air in six of the largest U.S. markets.

entry.title: How Jensen Huang's return as NVIDIA's CEO is going over in China
entry.summary: In China, Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO is being met with a mixed reaction – as Beijing weighs whether it wants the US company's chips at all.

entry.title: Credit card perks are fueling airline profitability
entry.summary: Flying during the holidays can be pricey. So, airlines are pitching more and more specialty brand credit cards on your flight.

entry.title: What to know before using AI agents for Black Friday shopping
entry.summary: 59% of U.S. shoppers plan to use AI for holiday shopping this weekend, according to the National Retail Federation

entry.title: Buying new things feels wonderful. But it can also be a trap
entry.summary: Constantly buying new things can be problematic, says journalist Eric Athas, author of the new book "Saying No to New." Here's how to break the cycle and find joy in what you already have.

entry.title: In a time of rising costs, one Thanksgiving commodity is cheaper: cannabis
entry.summary: Steep discounts for "Green Wednesday," one of the highest-selling days for cannabis, help customers keep costs down. But experts say retailers are feeling the pinch.

entry.title: Nvidia's board under fire for handling of CEO's alleged affairs
entry.summary: Even as Jensen Huang has returned to work, Nvidia's board is facing criticism over how it handled the crisis brought on by the CEO's alleged affairs.

entry.title: Unpacking President Trump's financial stake in Nvidia
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with Dan Alexander, a senior editor at Forbes and author of a book about President Trump's businesses, about the president's holdings in Nvidia given recent news.

entry.title: What should it cost to insure a home in wildfire country?
entry.summary: Some California homeowners have spent thousands making their homes safer from wildfires. Yet all that work has barely made a dent in their insurance bills. Should they be getting a bigger break?

entry.title: For workplace culture champions, Jensen Huang's return is 'unfathomable'
entry.summary: Some who have worked to promote diversity and inclusion in Silicon Valley say Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia's CEO sends a message that all that matters is money.
